reason: I read labels and want a known dose and a real lab report for my batch, and this actually shows both. At $24.99 for the first box I can try it once without feeling stupid.
objection: Brand new, so there are no reviews yet. I have to open the lab report myself and make sure it is a real lab and the batch matches. And it is still two capsules every day.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page turned out to be generic or did not match a batch number, I would pass. Real reviews from buyers would make me reorder.
